strategy.read: DNX path: seed->growth with corporate design customers; the 200+ partner base is the diffusion stock.
IQT/SYN path: acquirer-network exits; expect acquired outcomes rather than IPO in category.
co-investment overlap (Cylance cluster) shows DNX and IQT/SYN are complementary (diffusion vs acquirer network), not competing.

systemDynamics.name: Exit-recycling loop
steps: Government/IC demand pulls early security startups (IQT/SYN)
exit proceeds recycle into next fund vintage
category knowledge concentrates in operator-led funds

systemDynamics.name: Cross-border diffusion loop (DNX)
steps: 200+ corporate partners + SPROUND provide first customers
US fund (San Mateo) adds second-stage capital

systemDynamics.name: Non-capital moat
notes: IQT/SYN: CISO network + design partners + acquirer network
DNX: corporate-partner network + venture studio (Alloy Partners)
